title: Ramanujan-type identities for alternating Hurwitz zeta functions
summary: Around 1910, in an unpublished manuscript, Ramanujan proposed the following identity for $ζ(2n+1)$: \[ \begin{aligned} α^{-n}\,&\left\{\dfrac{1}{2}\,ζ(2n + 1) + \sum_{m = 1}^{\infty}\dfrac{m^{-2n - 1}}{e^{2αm} - 1}\right\} \\ &\quad\quad\quad\quad\quad\quad\quad-(-β)^{-n}\,\left\{\dfrac{1}{2}\,ζ(2n + 1) + \sum_{m = 1}^{\infty}\dfrac{m^{-2n - 1}}{e^{2βm} - 1}\right\}\\ &=2^{2n}\sum_{k = 0}^{n + 1}\dfrac{(-1)^{k-1}B_{2k}\,B_{2n - 2k + 2}}{(2k)!(2n - 2k + 2)!}\,α^{n - k + 1}β^k, \end{aligned} \] where $α$, $β$ are positive numbers satisfying $αβ=π^2,n\in\mathbb{N},$ $B_n$ denotes the $n$-th…
